item.title: Scissor Sisters Unearth ‘Sweet Footage’ From Kylie Minogue Recording Sessions In 2004
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest music news and trends. Today, we're talking about a blast from the past. The Scissor Sisters, a queer pop icon group, have been feeling nostalgic about their collaboration with the one and only Kylie Minogue."
[Soft music transitions in]
Host: "After watching the Kylie Minogue documentary on Netflix, the Scissor Sisters dug up some 'sweet footage' from a recording session over 20 years ago. The result? A delicious electro-pop nugget called 'I Believe in You', which has been remixed by the likes of Skylark and Mylo."
[Clip of "I Believe in You" plays in the background]
Host: "The footage shows Kylie, wearing a leopard print dress, working with Scissor Sisters' Jake Shears and Babydaddy in the studio. It's a rare, behind-the-scenes look at a collaboration coming together, with handwritten lyrics and Babydaddy's production wizardry."
[Clip ends, music transitions back]
Host: "The Scissor Sisters have had an amazing run in the UK, with 10 Top 40 singles and two number one albums. And Kylie, of course, is a chart superstar with eight number one singles and 11 number one albums. It's no wonder they're both adored in the UK, and we're excited to see what they have in store for us next."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to this episode of our podcast. If you want to hear more about the latest music trends and collaborations, be sure to subscribe to our show. Until next time, stay musical!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
